name: collection_index
description: Build the index the rest of the work needs: every file in a collection with its size, its sha256, the path it has now and the path it had on the machine, undoing the rewrites collectors make — a drive letter turned into a directory, a named stream's colon replaced, a reserved name escaped.

hash.description: Hash every file (default true; false is much faster on a large tree)

limit.description: Maximum entries to return inline when out_file is set (default 2000); the complete index is written to out_file

out_file.description: Optional JSONL path for the complete index; when absent every entry is returned inline
